quests.question: She ignored her parents' advice and followed her own plan; as a teen she was _____.
quests.explanation: Ignoring advice and following her own plan shows a wilful nature, so headstrong fits.

quests.question: The tea had been left for an hour, neither hot nor cold; it was _____.
quests.explanation: 'Neither hot nor cold' after an hour describes mild warmth, so lukewarm fits; scalding and freezing contradict.

quests.question: She called every hour, knocked on his door and wouldn't take no for an answer, asking _____.
quests.explanation: Calling hourly, knocking and refusing 'no' show she pressed firmly and repeatedly: insistently.

quests.question: Seeing the storm, he tripled the price of umbrellas on the spot; his move was _____.
quests.explanation: Tripling prices the moment a storm hits means exploiting a chance for gain: opportunistic.

quests.question: The statue's foot alone was taller than a man, and the whole figure towered over the city; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A foot taller than a man and a figure towering over the city show enormous size: gigantic.

quests.question: Mud on the walls, grease on the stove and rubbish on the floor made the kitchen _____.
quests.explanation: Mud, grease and rubbish mean the kitchen was very dirty, so filthy fits; spotless contradicts.

quests.question: Ten forms, five signatures and three weeks to renew a library card; the process is _____.
quests.explanation: Ten forms, five signatures and three weeks for a simple card waste time and effort: inefficient.

quests.question: Once he decided, no argument or evidence could move him; his refusal was totally _____.
quests.explanation: Refusing to be moved by argument or evidence is as stubborn as a mule, so mulish fits.

quests.question: Polished floors and freshly cleaned windows made the lobby _____.
quests.explanation: Polished floors and freshly cleaned windows make a place shine, so gleaming fits; grimy contradicts.

quests.question: Tired and cramped, the passengers snapped at each other and the crew; they grew _____.
quests.explanation: Snapping at one another and the crew when tired and cramped shows irritable quarrelling: fractious.

quests.question: Untied laces, a torn jacket and uncombed hair made the boy look _____.
quests.explanation: Untied laces, a torn jacket and uncombed hair show an untidy appearance: scruffy; neat contradicts.

quests.question: The horse refused every command and resisted every attempt at training; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Refusing commands and resisting training shows stubborn resistance to control: refractory.

quests.question: The shoes had thin soles and tall heels; for a mountain trek they were _____.
quests.explanation: Thin soles and tall heels do not suit a mountain trek, so impractical fits; ideal contradicts.

quests.question: Children ran across desks, shouted over the teacher and tore up papers; the class was _____.
quests.explanation: Running on desks, shouting over the teacher and tearing papers show no control: unruly.

quests.question: The gift arrived two weeks after the birthday, so she thanked him _____.
quests.explanation: A gift two weeks after the birthday means the thanks came late, so belatedly fits.

quests.question: Ordered to attend court, he ignored the summons and insulted the judge; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Ignoring a court order and insulting the judge is stubborn defiance of authority: contumacious.

quests.question: Losing him would change nothing, so the company treated his job as _____.
quests.explanation: 'Losing him would change nothing' means he could be spared, so expendable fits; vital contradicts.

quests.question: Sunshine, a surprise gift and dinner with friends made her birthday _____.
quests.explanation: Sunshine, a surprise gift and friends all add happiness, so wonderful fits; dreadful contradicts.

quests.question: The teddy was soft, round and warm from being hugged; every child found it _____.
quests.explanation: Being soft, round and warm from hugging makes a toy lovely to hold, so cuddly fits.

quests.question: Every few months, the engineer checks the bridge for cracks; she inspects it _____.
quests.explanation: Checking every few months means at regular intervals, so periodically fits; constantly contradicts.

quests.question: Scolded a hundred times, he still turned up late and laughed; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Staying the same after a hundred scoldings means he cannot be reformed: incorrigible.

quests.question: Until a permanent director is hired, Mr Ali will serve as _____ manager.
quests.explanation: 'Until a permanent director is hired' shows his role is temporary, so interim fits.

quests.question: He had no idea the file contained secrets, so he _____ sent it to the rival.
quests.explanation: 'No idea' about the secrets means he did it without realising, so unwittingly fits.

quests.question: Without a single doubt, she backed the plan and urged everyone to join, supporting it _____.
quests.explanation: No doubt and urging others to join show complete commitment, so wholeheartedly fits.

quests.question: After the scare, his voice trembled and his hands wobbled; he felt _____.
quests.explanation: A trembling voice and wobbling hands show unsteadiness, so shaky fits; steady and firm contradict.

quests.question: I needed a magnifying glass to see the insect, so small it fit on a grain of rice; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Needing a magnifying glass and fitting on a grain of rice show very small size, so tiny fits.

quests.question: Without her, nobody knew the filing system, the passwords or the clients; she is _____.
quests.explanation: If nobody else knows the system, passwords or clients, she cannot be done without: indispensable.

quests.question: The boy skipped class, ignored curfew and drifted from friend to friend; he was truly _____.
quests.explanation: Skipping class and ignoring curfew show someone who goes his own unruly way: wayward.

quests.question: Asked to move the table, the waiter did so at once with a smile, acting _____.
quests.explanation: Acting at once and with a smile when asked shows willing helpfulness, so obligingly fits.

quests.question: The soup was cold, the bus late and the film ended in a power cut; the whole evening was _____.
quests.explanation: Cold soup, a late bus and a power cut all went wrong, so awful fits; wonderful contradicts the story.
